model.name: REST transport is the scenario unit JSON — internal content moves as an idempotent unit-JSON PUT by uuid, never multipart
model.description: THINK WHAT REST MEANS: REpresentational State Transfer — the representation of state IS the scenario unit JSON, so every internal transfer carries unit JSON and NOTHING ELSE. In-app content transfers as an IDEMPOTENT unit-JSON PUT by uuid (same uuid + same content = no-op), NOT multipart, NOT a bespoke payload. Deletes the hand-rolled transport layer that caused the week-long outage.
